blocking_findings: The distinctive positive result is a classical Lipschitz-envelope and action-witness construction whose ReLU realization does not establish a method-specific neural advantage.
The tighter certificate does not improve any declared first-crossing resolution, and the spline is faster in all thirty common successful target-by-repetition comparisons.
The R46 catalogue contains no direct expected-policy-cost comparison for the new witness policy.
The executed witness evidence remains scalar and tensor-cover dependent; the state-dependent feasible-witness extension is not a comparative performance study.
The constructive theorem assumes certified covering, integration, feasible-net and repair primitives that can contain the main computational difficulty.
The exact rational selector and state-acquisition contract are not exercised under realistic finite-precision deployment.
Three deterministic timing repetitions and primitive counts do not establish a general efficiency or scaling advantage.
The stylized investment laboratory does not yield an Econometrica-scale substantive economic result enabled by the witness method.
The broad Neural Bellman Operators platform framing remains disproportionate to the completed witness-certification result.
limitations: The reviewer did not rerun or retime the thirty-six services; a new execution would create new timing observations.

The reviewer verified the source-bound artifact, all frozen source and checkpoint identities, aggregate calculations and a central exact algebraic property, but did not independently re-prove every inherited theorem.
Single-host deterministic clocks support no hardware-general performance inference.
No claim is made that spline or a non-neural envelope dominates outside the declared R46 scalar economies.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
positive_findings: R46 is a complete, immutable, review-ready source-and-evidence snapshot.
The one-sided policy sandwich appears internally coherent under its stated monotonicity and cash-invariance assumptions.
The action witness is retained through dominated labels, ties and exact scalar compilation.
Both nearest-node comparators receive strengthened one-sided certificates.
The prospective study executes all thirty-six services and 216 rungs and retains every failure.
The feasible-witness theorem makes state-dependent admissibility and repair costs explicit.
All adverse target, timing, policy-ranking and precision findings remain visible.
Provenance, checkpoint hashing, preservation, tests and clean rebuilds are exceptionally strong.
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not continue the cumulative manuscript through another ordinary revision round. A new, sharply focused paper on witness-preserving Bellman policy certification and deterministic Lipschitz–ReLU construction could merit evaluation, but R46 does not establish an Econometrica-level method-specific contribution for the broad Neural Bellman Operators program.
